newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica details mobile, int'l business.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica details mobile, int'l business.

text.p: Among the most dynamic components in Spain's Telefonica results in the first nine month of 1996 were Mobile phones and International business.
In a statement on Friday, Telefonica said mobile phone turnover increased in the first nine-months by 114.8 pct to 178.75 billion pesetas.

The total number of mobile phones reached 1,785,234, including 506,930 clients in digital GSM which was launched in July 1995. Movistar had a monopoly on the Spanish GSM digital mobile phone market until competitor Airtel began operations in October 1995.
In the GSM segment, the number of clients increased 59 percent in the third quarter over the second, the company added.

International business turnover rose by 15.6 percent to 258.31 billion pesetas. It added that the biggest part of the new business was originated in Telefonica del Peru, which saw a 34 percent increase in the number of contracts to 1,329,339.
Compania Telefonica del Chile showed an increase of 16 percent in contracts up to 1,949,773.
